about: How a Prism3 Figma file is laid out and named: pages, components, icons, native slots, variables and canvas furniture. Generated from the code; do not edit by hand.

pages.rule: The cover page comes first. Each section is a native page divider, then an empty header page named for the section, then its component pages. A component page's name starts with "↳ "; the cover and the section headers have no prefix.

components.rule: A component set is named for its def id, and each member for its variant values in Figma's `key=value, key=value` form. A def that builds single components names each `<id>/<value>`.

privatePrefix.rule: A def id that starts with "_" is a building block: it is only ever nested inside another component, and Figma leaves it out of a published library because of the prefix.
privatePrefix.source: packages/engine/component-schema.ts#optionally led by '_' for a building block

placement.rule: A component builds onto the one page its family maps to in the taxonomy. A building block made for one component sits on that component's page. The Subcomponents section holds the parts placed there to be nested or swapped in elsewhere. Section membership is set in the taxonomy, not derived from what nests what.

codeOnly.rule: An axis or state listed under a component's `codeOnly` exists in code and has no Figma variant; the component doc says why. Code-only props are named in the same doc, not here.

icons.rule: Each glyph is its own component named "icon/<glyph>". A glyph inside another component is an instance of one of them; where a part wraps it in a frame, the instance's layer is named "glyph".

nativeSlots.rule: A native slot is a region a designer fills in place on an instance. The set has one SLOT property named for the part. Its default content is a placeholder, and text inside it is literal: Figma accepts no component property on a slot sublayer. Settings left out take Figma's defaults: no child limit, any content, default content shown.

variables.rule: Every variable is named "<root>/<path>", the token's path below the brand root with "/" for ".". Primitives carry the "core" tier after the root: "<root>/core/<group>/…". Style names carry neither the root nor the tier. The root is the brand's own; an input that declares none gets "prism".
variables.source: packages/engine/emit-figma.ts#EVERY VARIABLE NAME NOW CARRIES THE BRAND ROOT

canvasFurniture.rule: Canvas furniture is drawn around a component set on its page and is never part of the set: label instances for its rows and columns, and backdrops behind its inverse or modal members. Each instance carries shared plugin data under namespace "prism3", key "furniture", so a reader can skip it.

fileTemplates.rule: Page headers are instances of these sets. They live on the Sandbox section's file components page with the furniture templates, and their names start with "_" so a library leaves them out.
